meta.title: Shining Singularity
meta.description: From singularities to the heat death of the universe, the most amazing miracle of the cosmos is not any mere object that occupies it, but every moment that transpires therein.

units.rawText: Jiutian sector, at the Admin Center of the Jovian Ringworld.
units.displayText: Jiutian sector, at the Admin Center of the Jovian Ringworld.

spans.text: Jiutian sector, at the Admin Center of the Jovian Ringworld.

units.rawText: Mind your feet, Professor. The Jovian Ringworld has gravity generator systems.
units.displayText: Mind your feet, Professor. The Jovian Ringworld has gravity generator systems.

spans.text: Mind your feet, Professor. The Jovian Ringworld has gravity generator systems.

units.rawText: Huh...Well, it's reassuring to have a floor with proper gravity under me.
units.displayText: Huh...Well, it's reassuring to have a floor with proper gravity under me.

spans.text: Huh...Well, it's reassuring to have a floor with proper gravity under me.

units.rawText: Hehe, well, you DID rush over immediately the moment you finished your basic training.
units.displayText: Hehe, well, you DID rush over immediately the moment you finished your basic training.

spans.text: Hehe, well, you DID rush over immediately the moment you finished your basic training.

units.rawText: It took me a month to clear the final exam back then.
units.displayText: It took me a month to clear the final exam back then.

spans.text: It took me a month to clear the final exam back then.

units.rawText: Fresnel supports me as I walk, helping me adjust to going from a zero-G environment to normal gravity.
units.displayText: Fresnel supports me as I walk, helping me adjust to going from a zero-G environment to normal gravity.

spans.text: Fresnel supports me as I walk, helping me adjust to going from a zero-G environment to normal gravity.

units.rawText: Well, I didn't want to keep our friends waiting for too long.
units.displayText: Well, I didn't want to keep our friends waiting for too long.

spans.text: Well, I didn't want to keep our friends waiting for too long.

units.rawText: ...You're right.
units.displayText: ...You're right.

spans.text: ...You're right.

units.rawText: Professor of the Oasis, <cmdr>, welcome to the Jiutian sector.
units.displayText: Professor of the Oasis, {교수}, welcome to the Jiutian sector.

spans.text: Professor of the Oasis,
, welcome to the Jiutian sector.

units.rawText: Just as I finish acclimating to the gravity here, a unique-looking agent comes to meet us.
units.displayText: Just as I finish acclimating to the gravity here, a unique-looking agent comes to meet us.

spans.text: Just as I finish acclimating to the gravity here, a unique-looking agent comes to meet us.

units.rawText: I am Xuannu, the administrator of the Jiutian sector.
units.displayText: I am Xuannu, the administrator of the Jiutian sector.

spans.text: I am Xuannu, the administrator of the Jiutian sector.

units.rawText: Greetings.
units.displayText: Greetings.

spans.text: Greetings.

units.rawText: Miss Fresnel, it's been a whole. Thank you for protecting the research data and agent backups for the Jiutian sector... It allowed us to be reborn.
units.displayText: Miss Fresnel, it's been a whole. Thank you for protecting the research data and agent backups for the Jiutian sector... It allowed us to be reborn.

spans.text: Miss Fresnel, it's been a whole. Thank you for protecting the research data and agent backups for the Jiutian sector... It allowed us to be reborn.

units.rawText: I didn't protect it by myself. The credit for that goes to you... and everyone who fought for Jiutian.
units.displayText: I didn't protect it by myself. The credit for that goes to you... and everyone who fought for Jiutian.

spans.text: I didn't protect it by myself. The credit for that goes to you... and everyone who fought for Jiutian.

units.rawText: I was simply the last one who held on to it.
units.displayText: I was simply the last one who held on to it.

spans.text: I was simply the last one who held on to it.

units.rawText: Even so, you still have our utmost gratitude.
units.displayText: Even so, you still have our utmost gratitude.

spans.text: Even so, you still have our utmost gratitude.

units.rawText: How has Jiutian been recently?
units.displayText: How has Jiutian been recently?

spans.text: How has Jiutian been recently?

units.rawText: Currently, it has largely finished restoring itself from backups...
units.displayText: Currently, it has largely finished restoring itself from backups...

spans.text: Currently, it has largely finished restoring itself from backups...

units.rawText: And thanks to the support from the Oasis, we managed to finish rebuilding quickly.
units.displayText: And thanks to the support from the Oasis, we managed to finish rebuilding quickly.

spans.text: And thanks to the support from the Oasis, we managed to finish rebuilding quickly.

units.rawText: What about the HD Entropics? Our Antonina had a hypothesis that... the activation of the Heat Death was related to the all-out entropic invasion of Magrasea.
units.displayText: What about the HD Entropics? Our Antonina had a hypothesis that... the activation of the Heat Death was related to the all-out entropic invasion of Magrasea.

spans.text: What about the HD Entropics? Our Antonina had a hypothesis that... the activation of the Heat Death was related to the all-out entropic invasion of Magrasea.

units.rawText: As for that, we're monitoring the situation in real time, and Yuwang did some analysis of his own...
units.displayText: As for that, we're monitoring the situation in real time, and Yuwang did some analysis of his own...

spans.text: As for that, we're monitoring the situation in real time, and Yuwang did some analysis of his own...

units.rawText: Before Xuannu can finish, a set of footsteps and arguing voices reach us from outside.
units.displayText: Before Xuannu can finish, a set of footsteps and arguing voices reach us from outside.

spans.text: Before Xuannu can finish, a set of footsteps and arguing voices reach us from outside.

units.rawText: What was that maneuver just now? I don't recall that being part of the training schedule.
units.displayText: What was that maneuver just now? I don't recall that being part of the training schedule.

spans.text: What was that maneuver just now? I don't recall that being part of the training schedule.

units.rawText: It was a snap decision I made as a taikonaut.
units.displayText: It was a snap decision I made as a taikonaut.

spans.text: It was a snap decision I made as a taikonaut.

units.rawText: Didn't I complete the mission without a hitch?
units.displayText: Didn't I complete the mission without a hitch?

spans.text: Didn't I complete the mission without a hitch?

units.rawText: ...Alright, I admit that stunt worked very well, but all the same, please stick to the program during a training exercise instead of randomly adding new items on a whim.
units.displayText: ...Alright, I admit that stunt worked very well, but all the same, please stick to the program during a training exercise instead of randomly adding new items on a whim.

spans.text: ...Alright, I admit that stunt worked very well, but all the same, please stick to the program during a training exercise instead of randomly adding new items on a whim.

units.rawText: (Sigh) You just don't get it, do you, partner? After all, a vivid imagination and unflagging determination are both equally essential.
units.displayText: (Sigh) You just don't get it, do you, partner? After all, a vivid imagination and unflagging determination are both equally essential.

spans.text: (Sigh) You just don't get it, do you, partner? After all, a vivid imagination and unflagging determination are both equally essential.

units.rawText: Also, it wasn't "on a whim". It was a decision I reached after careful consideration and consultation of my experiences.
units.displayText: Also, it wasn't "on a whim". It was a decision I reached after careful consideration and consultation of my experiences.

spans.text: Also, it wasn't "on a whim". It was a decision I reached after careful consideration and consultation of my experiences.

units.rawText: (Sigh) Then at least clear it with me before you do it next time, otherwise...
units.displayText: (Sigh) Then at least clear it with me before you do it next time, otherwise...

spans.text: (Sigh) Then at least clear it with me before you do it next time, otherwise...

units.rawText: Alright, alright, I'll buy you a meal—
units.displayText: Alright, alright, I'll buy you a meal—

spans.text: Alright, alright, I'll buy you a meal—

units.rawText: Swoosh—
units.displayText: Swoosh—

spans.text: Swoosh—

units.rawText: The door to the Admin Center opens, and two Dolls enter.
units.displayText: The door to the Admin Center opens, and two Dolls enter.

spans.text: The door to the Admin Center opens, and two Dolls enter.

units.rawText: Xuannu, morning! Huh...
units.displayText: Xuannu, morning! Huh...

spans.text: Xuannu, morning! Huh...

units.rawText: What a coincidence...
units.displayText: What a coincidence...

spans.text: What a coincidence...

units.rawText: Speak of the devil.
units.displayText: Speak of the devil.

spans.text: Speak of the devil.

units.rawText: Are you Fresnel? Hehe, I can tell that you've got a lot of potential as a taikonaut!
units.displayText: Are you Fresnel? Hehe, I can tell that you've got a lot of potential as a taikonaut!

spans.text: Are you Fresnel? Hehe, I can tell that you've got a lot of potential as a taikonaut!

units.rawText: A taikonaut, you say... Hehe, yes, people have told me that before.
units.displayText: A taikonaut, you say... Hehe, yes, people have told me that before.

spans.text: A taikonaut, you say... Hehe, yes, people have told me that before.

units.rawText: Nice to meet you, Xinghuan and Yuwang.
units.displayText: Nice to meet you, Xinghuan and Yuwang.

spans.text: Nice to meet you, Xinghuan and Yuwang.

units.rawText: I believe this is the first time we've met... Or rather, it should be "the first time we've met in a while" to you, right?
units.displayText: I believe this is the first time we've met... Or rather, it should be "the first time we've met in a while" to you, right?

spans.text: I believe this is the first time we've met... Or rather, it should be "the first time we've met in a while" to you, right?

units.rawText: Yeah... Well, in any case, we'll have many more chance to meet later on, so that'll do.
units.displayText: Yeah... Well, in any case, we'll have many more chance to meet later on, so that'll do.

spans.text: Yeah... Well, in any case, we'll have many more chance to meet later on, so that'll do.

units.rawText: What brings you to Jiutian, Fresnel? Hm, and you would be...
units.displayText: What brings you to Jiutian, Fresnel? Hm, and you would be...

spans.text: What brings you to Jiutian, Fresnel? Hm, and you would be...

units.rawText: Taikonaut Xinghuan, ground control monitor Yuwang, I am Professor <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Taikonaut Xinghuan, ground control monitor Yuwang, I am Professor {교수}.

spans.text: Taikonaut Xinghuan, ground control monitor Yuwang, I am Professor

units.rawText: Ah, you must be the one Xuannu mentioned...
units.displayText: Ah, you must be the one Xuannu mentioned...

spans.text: Ah, you must be the one Xuannu mentioned...

units.rawText: Hi, Professor! I'm Xinghuan. Liuxing, say hi to the Professor, too!
units.displayText: Hi, Professor! I'm Xinghuan. Liuxing, say hi to the Professor, too!

spans.text: Hi, Professor! I'm Xinghuan. Liuxing, say hi to the Professor, too!

units.rawText: Beepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeep—

units.rawText: I'm glad you're here, Yuwang. Please explain the conclusion regarding the HD Entropics.
units.displayText: I'm glad you're here, Yuwang. Please explain the conclusion regarding the HD Entropics.

spans.text: I'm glad you're here, Yuwang. Please explain the conclusion regarding the HD Entropics.

units.rawText: The HD Entropics, hm... I understand.
units.displayText: The HD Entropics, hm... I understand.

spans.text: The HD Entropics, hm... I understand.

units.rawText: According to the files provided by Miss Anna and the data protected by Miss Fresnel... We can conclude that these HD Entropics and the regular entropics in Magrasea have the same kind of base layer logic.
units.displayText: According to the files provided by Miss Anna and the data protected by Miss Fresnel... We can conclude that these HD Entropics and the regular entropics in Magrasea have the same kind of base layer logic.

spans.text: According to the files provided by Miss Anna and the data protected by Miss Fresnel... We can conclude that these HD Entropics and the regular entropics in Magrasea have the same kind of base layer logic.

units.rawText: However, that only means they have similarities in their base-layer framework. They are fundamentally two different classes of entities.
units.displayText: However, that only means they have similarities in their base-layer framework. They are fundamentally two different classes of entities.

spans.text: However, that only means they have similarities in their base-layer framework. They are fundamentally two different classes of entities.

units.rawText: On the screen, Yuwang brings up the information on the HD Entropics. One particular High Order Entropic draws my attention.
units.displayText: On the screen, Yuwang brings up the information on the HD Entropics. One particular High Order Entropic draws my attention.

spans.text: On the screen, Yuwang brings up the information on the HD Entropics. One particular High Order Entropic draws my attention.

units.rawText: Hm? Do you have any thoughts about this High Order HD Entropic?
units.displayText: Hm? Do you have any thoughts about this High Order HD Entropic?

spans.text: Hm? Do you have any thoughts about this High Order HD Entropic?

options.rawText: I know her name... It's Caina.
options.displayText: I know her name... It's Caina.

spans.text: I know her name... It's Caina.
She looks kind of dumb.

units.rawText: There's a High Order Entropic in Magrasea that resembles this HD Entropic. And they're both called Caina.
units.displayText: There's a High Order Entropic in Magrasea that resembles this HD Entropic. And they're both called Caina.

spans.text: There's a High Order Entropic in Magrasea that resembles this HD Entropic. And they're both called Caina.

units.rawText: ...I don't think that's a coincidence...
units.displayText: ...I don't think that's a coincidence...

spans.text: ...I don't think that's a coincidence...

units.rawText: But if the entropics and these HD Entropics had the same base layer logic...
units.displayText: But if the entropics and these HD Entropics had the same base layer logic...

spans.text: But if the entropics and these HD Entropics had the same base layer logic...

units.rawText: Then it's very likely that the reason why the Heat Death activated early was because of the full-scale entropic assault on Magrasea.
units.displayText: Then it's very likely that the reason why the Heat Death activated early was because of the full-scale entropic assault on Magrasea.

spans.text: Then it's very likely that the reason why the Heat Death activated early was because of the full-scale entropic assault on Magrasea.

units.rawText: Anna reached a similar conclusion herself...
units.displayText: Anna reached a similar conclusion herself...

spans.text: Anna reached a similar conclusion herself...

units.rawText: ...Unfortunately, we lack sufficient data to theorize any further than this.
units.displayText: ...Unfortunately, we lack sufficient data to theorize any further than this.

spans.text: ...Unfortunately, we lack sufficient data to theorize any further than this.

units.rawText: Thank you for the explanation, Yuwang. So, what about the HD Entropics left in Jiutian?
units.displayText: Thank you for the explanation, Yuwang. So, what about the HD Entropics left in Jiutian?

spans.text: Thank you for the explanation, Yuwang. So, what about the HD Entropics left in Jiutian?

units.rawText: ...After the reset of the Jiutian sector, we found a certain region of space.
units.displayText: ...After the reset of the Jiutian sector, we found a certain region of space.

spans.text: ...After the reset of the Jiutian sector, we found a certain region of space.

units.rawText: That region... was not reset.
units.displayText: That region... was not reset.

spans.text: That region... was
not
reset.

units.rawText: Ah, I scouted around it. That region felt really chaotic and dangerous.
units.displayText: Ah, I scouted around it. That region felt really chaotic and dangerous.

spans.text: Ah, I scouted around it. That region felt really chaotic and dangerous.

units.rawText: None of our instruments could probe it.
units.displayText: None of our instruments could probe it.

spans.text: None of our instruments could probe it.

units.rawText: Xinghuan rubs the back of her head, as though there's more she wants to say.
units.displayText: Xinghuan rubs the back of her head, as though there's more she wants to say.

spans.text: Xinghuan rubs the back of her head, as though there's more she wants to say.

units.rawText: Xinghuan?
units.displayText: Xinghuan?

spans.text: Xinghuan?

units.rawText: Ah... Well, I might be imagining things, but...
units.displayText: Ah... Well, I might be imagining things, but...

spans.text: Ah... Well, I might be imagining things, but...

units.rawText: When I went near that region... I had a feeling of nostalgia.
units.displayText: When I went near that region... I had a feeling of nostalgia.

spans.text: When I went near that region... I had a feeling of nostalgia.

units.rawText: Nostalgia?
units.displayText: Nostalgia?

spans.text: Nostalgia?

units.rawText: Upon hearing Xinghuan's words, I exchange a glance with Fresnel.
units.displayText: Upon hearing Xinghuan's words, I exchange a glance with Fresnel.

spans.text: Upon hearing Xinghuan's words, I exchange a glance with Fresnel.

units.rawText: It appears you and Fresnel know what it is, Professor?
units.displayText: It appears you and Fresnel know what it is, Professor?

spans.text: It appears you and Fresnel know what it is, Professor?

units.rawText: I wouldn't say we know what it is... More like, we have a hunch.
units.displayText: I wouldn't say we know what it is... More like, we have a hunch.

spans.text: I wouldn't say we know what it is... More like, we have a hunch.

units.rawText: You see... We lost a friend in Jiutian.
units.displayText: You see... We lost a friend in Jiutian.

spans.text: You see... We lost a friend in Jiutian.

units.rawText: Before she boarded our ship... Hubble secretly brought a copy of all the agents' backups with her. In the end, she allowed herself to be consumed by the Heat Death in order to protect those backups.
units.displayText: Before she boarded our ship... Hubble secretly brought a copy of all the agents' backups with her. In the end, she allowed herself to be consumed by the Heat Death in order to protect those backups.

spans.text: Before she boarded our ship... Hubble secretly brought a copy of all the agents' backups with her. In the end, she allowed herself to be consumed by the Heat Death in order to protect those backups.

units.rawText: She knew that the others would stop her if they knew she'd brought their backups with her... So she did it in secret, without telling anyone.
units.displayText: She knew that the others would stop her if they knew she'd brought their backups with her... So she did it in secret, without telling anyone.

spans.text: She knew that the others would stop her if they knew she'd brought their backups with her... So she did it in secret, without telling anyone.

units.rawText: Hubble... For some reason, that name sounds really familiar...
units.displayText: Hubble... For some reason, that name sounds really familiar...

spans.text: Hubble... For some reason, that name sounds really familiar...

units.rawText: Still, logic dictates that the Oasis should have a backup of Hubble. Surely you could reset her, right?
units.displayText: Still, logic dictates that the Oasis should have a backup of Hubble. Surely you could reset her, right?

spans.text: Still, logic dictates that the Oasis should have a backup of Hubble. Surely you could reset her, right?

units.rawText: Well... we tried, but it didn't work. We theorize that it's similar to how agents who are entropized have their backups entropized, too. Perhaps Hubble was eaten away by the HD Entropics and could not be reset.
units.displayText: Well... we tried, but it didn't work. We theorize that it's similar to how agents who are entropized have their backups entropized, too. Perhaps Hubble was eaten away by the HD Entropics and could not be reset.

spans.text: Well... we tried, but it didn't work. We theorize that it's similar to how agents who are entropized have their backups entropized, too. Perhaps Hubble was eaten away by the HD Entropics and could not be reset.

units.rawText: There are missing pieces in Hubble's backup data, and parts of Jiutian which could not be reset...
units.displayText: There are missing pieces in Hubble's backup data, and parts of Jiutian which could not be reset...

units.rawText: I don't think this is a coincidence.
units.displayText: I don't think this is a coincidence.

spans.text: I don't think this is a coincidence.

units.rawText: I look at the main screen, at that patch of space that's colored a bewitching purple.
units.displayText: I look at the main screen, at that patch of space that's colored a bewitching purple.

spans.text: I look at the main screen, at that patch of space that's colored a bewitching purple.

units.rawText: An eerie sensation fills my body, as though someone was spying on us.
units.displayText: An eerie sensation fills my body, as though someone was spying on us.

spans.text: An eerie sensation fills my body, as though someone was spying on us.

units.rawText: What... was that just now?
units.displayText: What... was that just now?

spans.text: What... was that just now?

units.rawText: Fresnel... Did you feel it, too?
units.displayText: Fresnel... Did you feel it, too?

spans.text: Fresnel... Did you feel it, too?

units.rawText: The stars shine in the boundless cosmos.
units.displayText: The stars shine in the boundless cosmos.

spans.text: The stars shine in the boundless cosmos.

units.rawText: In the eldritch void, a crimson planet sees its first rays of daylight.
units.displayText: In the eldritch void, a crimson planet sees its first rays of daylight.

spans.text: In the eldritch void, a crimson planet sees its first rays of daylight.

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>So this is the light of daybreak... how dazzling it is...</color>
units.displayText: So this is the light of daybreak... how dazzling it is...

spans.text: So this is the light of daybreak... how dazzling it is...

units.rawText: A slumbering iris wakes from her dreams and lazily reaches a hand out to block out the light of dawn.
units.displayText: A slumbering iris wakes from her dreams and lazily reaches a hand out to block out the light of dawn.

spans.text: A slumbering iris wakes from her dreams and lazily reaches a hand out to block out the light of dawn.
